name: react-admin

mutations.description: Remove the Tags item from the nav menu. The /#tags screen still exists and is now unreachable through the UI — the shape a walk is uniquely placed to catch, since nothing about the route changed

Unwire the light/dark toggle. Its whole effect is colour, so this only fails to be caught if the visual signal is not working on real DOM — the exact case issue #1 was about, on an app nobody here wrote
Unwire the toolbar Refresh button so it re-renders nothing. It reads as state-changed in a healthy walk because the list re-fetches

Remove the per-row Edit button from the posts table. Six walked edges disappear at once, which is also the case #50 cares about: a real removal must still read as gone, not be excused as a budget eviction

note: The checkout at cwd must already have its dependencies installed; there is no install step here on purpose. Vite aliases every workspace package to its src, so a mutation to source takes effect on the next serve with nothing to rebuild — and an install per mutation would be four minutes of nothing, and would hide a genuine install failure inside a mutation result.
